game_updates.title: Launching Devoid of Liberty: A Look Back
game_updates.contents: From the desk of our Creative Director, Mikael ErikssonHelldivers,The Void has been pierced and the Illuminate's latest shenanigans have been decisively dealt with! Well done! The Devoid of Liberty launch has run its course and history has been written. Before we dive into whatever comes next, I wanted to take a moment and talk about how I personally think this update landed. What We Were Going ForI consider Devoid of Liberty to be a ‘vertical slice’ of what we want this game to be every week. Not in terms of new content (we can’t keep up with that), but in terms of fantasy cohesion. The Void’s presence transcended the game: it was felt outside of the SE Destroyer windows and the Galactic War map. It was in what you read in the mission descriptions, what you saw on the battlefield, what yo...

game_updates.title: 1.18 Official Version and Beta Version Release
game_updates.contents: This update has the same version for both the official release and the betaThere’s no version 1.17 because that version never really made it—it was modified using AI, but after AI edits, the bugs kept increasing, so in the end, everything had to be redone and fixed manually. This version should be pretty close to stable. The liquid glass feature has also been worked on at the same time. Right now, the main issue is still resource usage, and there’s no really good way to capture the image behind a window yet. At the moment, we can only take screenshots and render them, which causes some display lag, especially when the window moves quickly behind the liquid glass. The GPU will always take some load. game_updates.title: An Update on the Processional of the Damned
game_updates.contents: Lord Captains! We have important news regarding the Processional of the Damned DLC for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader. We’re sorry it took us so long to bring you this update — we had to figure out a few things before making this announcement. Despite our best efforts to deliver the expansion by September as originally intended, it has become clear to us that it won't be ready in time. That's why, to ensure we deliver the experience players deserve, we have decided to delay the launch. The release window will be set to December, 2026 and is not expected to move any further. We sincerely apologise for this situation, and greatly value your patience and understanding. We realize that the longer wait might upset some of our fans, especially those who'd like to replay the game with ALL content...

Since the update, We’ve been keeping an eye on your feedback and have already fixed a bunch of issues. Here are today’s fixes :\Modified the cursor color of "Restore Terrain". \Lens automatic buffer capacity in Ray Receivers: 20->10.\Fixed a bug where loading a save would cause an error calculating proliferation level if the remaining Graviton Lens in a Ray Receiver was less than 1.Fixed a bug where the types and quantities of materials obtained from recycling the space capsule in a new game were incorrect.Fixed a bug where clicking the "Restore Terrain" button on gas giants would still incorrectly highlight the button.

game_updates.title: PSA: Connectivity and stability issues
game_updates.contents: Commanders, We are aware that players are continuing to experience connectivity and stability issues, including lag and stuttering. Our investigation indicates that there is no single direct cause that could be addressed with an immediate hotfix, and we are currently working across several areas in parallel. This includes investigation of the game client, external network routing, and our own server infrastructure. We have already made an initial round of infrastructure adjustments on our side and are currently monitoring their effect. Further adjustments are being tested, with another round of changes planned for this week once testing is completed. We have also identified indications of issues within external network infrastructure and traffic routing. We have narrowed down where part of...
